title: Products of surjective affine morphisms are surjective
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $J$ be a small set, and let $g_j:T_j\to S$ be surjective affine morphisms for $j\in J$. For the product $T=\prod_{j\in J}T_j$ supplied by [lem-trf-affine-infinite-product-existence], the projection $T\to S$ is surjective.

mathlib_searches.query: An arbitrary product of surjective morphisms of schemes over a base is surjective
mathlib_searches.results: pointsPi_surjective requires compactness/local-ring hypotheses; pullback surjectivity and jointly-surjective preservation only; no arbitrary product theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: Infinite products preserve surjective scheme morphisms
mathlib_searches.results: Function.Surjective.piMap and Scheme pullback surjectivity; no scheme product result.
No declaration matching arbitrary scheme products.
